title: Cookie MCP
shortDescription: The onchain execution layer for AI agents on Cookie Chain.
description: Cookie MCP is a Model Context Protocol server that enables AI agents to interact directly with Cookie Chain. Agents can execute swaps, launch tokens, provide liquidity, stake assets, bridge tokens, inspect balances, and interact with supported DeFi protocols through a unified interface.

title: Cookiepad
shortDescription: One-click token launchpad with live chain analytics on Cookie Chain — 100% client-side.
description: Cookiepad is a fully client-side dApp for Cookie Chain: launch a new SPL token with complete Metaplex metadata (name, symbol, supply, royalty, creator share) in a single signed transaction — the createMetadataV1 instruction is encoded by hand with no SDK lock-in. A live dashboard streams slot / epoch / TPS curve, active accounts and DBC pool accounts straight from the public RPC (rpc.cookiescan.io). My Tokens decodes every ATA in your wallet and reads on-chain Metaplex metadata client-side; Send COOK does native transfers. Stack: React 18 + Vite + Tailwind + Recharts + @solana/web3.js + @solana/spl-token. Wallets: Nightly, Phantom, Backpack, Solflare, Coinbase. Zero servers, zero API keys — hosted on GitHub Pages.
